fact_definition: Primary-source/company-reported assertion unless otherwise labeled. Derived diagnostics, estimates, inferences and opinions are separated from reported facts.

derived_diagnostics.note: OCF-PPE and OCF-PPE-SBC are mechanical diagnostics only. They are not normalized owner FCF because working-capital timing, intangible investment, manufacturing/supply commitments and other economic reinvestment are not fully normalized.

external_sources.use: Q2 revenue, margins, end-market revenue, operating cash flow, liquidity, DSO, inventory days, Q3 guidance, 800V sampling, capacity strategy and repurchase authorization.
H1 financial statements, PPE purchases, SBC, shares, distributor concentration, accounts-receivable concentration, internal-control status and litigation disclosures.
FY2025 financials, customer concentration, end-market mix, SBC, share count, FY2024 restatement, audit opinions and material-weakness history.
Long-term 300mm Singapore manufacturing partnership; volume production planned for early 2027.
Counter-evidence on grid-to-core and 800V competition. Any Gartner characterization is attributed to Infineon's release rather than treated as independently reconstructed market share.

source_quality_notes: SEC filings and company-filed exhibits lead quantitative financial and control claims.
The FY2024 tax restatement and unremediated material weakness are accounting-control facts, not evidence of intentional misconduct.
Securities litigation is an allegation and is not treated as proof of wrongdoing.
Distributor concentration is distinct from underlying end-customer concentration; the latter remains incompletely disclosed.
Management guidance, capacity targets and 800V sampling are forward-looking or pre-production evidence and are not scored as realized cash flows.
Secondary market price is a valuation reference, not an execution guarantee.
